text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall adjust my plans and use
this time
to rest.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Where am I? Last I recall, I was sleeping
in the
infirmary...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Flash, shouldn't we go to the gym soon?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, for class? What time is it?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Wha... This classroom has no clock!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Could it be that clocks—no, that the
very concept
of time doesn't exist?!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This cannot be... How can I possibly
survive in
such a world?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Wait... If there are no clocks, then I can
simply
become a clock myself.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the sun still exists, so if I
act as a
sundial and read the numbers
out loud...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I can create the concept of time!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Oh... what a relief. It was merely a
dream...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Still, it seems I can function surprisingly
well
without clocks... Hehe!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Flash, class is about to start.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
It's "about" to start? When is that,
exactly? The
time... You must tell me the
time!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her nice dream, Эйсин Флэш is
back to
her usual self.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, it was just an Albtraum... And what a terrible nightmare it was... I feel as though I didn't get a moment's rest... Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
